cli_result_compatibility.evidence: hermes_cli/kanban.py::_cmd_complete calls kb.complete_task directly (result=args.result, summary=summary); CLI path never routes through _handle_complete, so 'hermes kanban complete --result' is unaffected by the diff

exact_faulty_form_repro.evidence: test_message_3262_arg_form_is_rejected_and_card_not_done green against real temp-HERMES_HOME kernel DB; independently reproduced OLD handler behavior at base bb0785 in detached /tmp worktree: {artifacts, board} -> 'provide at least one of: summary (preferred), result', and result-only call COMPLETED the card at base (the old tolerance that caused the loop)
